shortcut: use the unique most frequent frame interior size as the kept size; copy the sole visible template pattern into those frames
finding: The sampler always makes every distractor size distinct, so the template-size class is the unique modal size. The public self_check grammar does not require distractor sizes to be mutually distinct and accepts a scene where three repeated distractors outnumber two template-size frames. The canonical rule follows the patterned template there, while the modal-size shortcut fails.
